bio.es: Mary Elle Fanning (Conyers, Georgia, Estados Unidos; 9 de abril de 1998) es una actriz estadounidense. Comenzó su carrera como actriz infantil antes de cumplir tres años, interpretando la versión más joven del personaje de su hermana mayor, Dakota Fanning, en Yo soy Sam (2001). Durante su infancia apareció en producciones destacadas como Babel (2006), El curioso caso de Benjamin Button (2008), Somewhere (2010), de Sofia Coppola, y Super 8 (2011), dirigida por J. J. Abrams. Alcanzó reconocimiento mundial en el cine comercial al interpretar a la princesa Aurora en Maléfica (2014) y su secuela Maléfica: Maestra del mal (2019).

conocida: El curioso caso de Benjamin Button

bio.en: Carlos González Fernández (born 24 May 1997) is a Spanish actor. Gonzalez studied acting at Estudio Corazza para la Actuación, the same school as fellow countryman Javier Bardem. Gonzalez had been acting in plays and shows, but hadn't made a debut in films until La Bola Negra (2026), playing Alberto. Gonzalez identifies as non-binary, and prefers both feminine and masculine pronouns.

conocida: Todas las veces que nos enamoramos

bio.en: Julio Torres (born February 11, 1987) is a Salvadoran-American writer, comedian, and actor. He is best known as a writer for Saturday Night Live and as the co-creator, writer, and executive producer of the HBO series Los Espookys. He previously wrote for The Chris Gethard Show on truTV.

conocida: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon

bio.en: María Gandiaga began her career at the age of seven with the musical “Sonrisas y Lágrimas” by the production company SOM Produce. In 2017, she began her audiovisual career, participating in short films such as “Como si con la comida se pudiera repartir cariño,” “La Pared de Gotelé Más Bonita del Mundo,” and “Epílogo,” among others, while continuing her training in Performing and Cinematic Arts. In 2026, she made her debut in her first feature film, “Ruega por nosotras,” directed by Daniel Monzón.

conocida: I'm Beginning To See the Light

bio.en: Rod Paradot (born 1996) is a French actor. He won the César Award for Most Promising Actor in 2016 for his role in Standing Tall. Source: Article "Rod Paradot" from Wikipedia in English, licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.

Rizwan Ahmed (born 1 December 1982) is a British actor and rapper. He has received several awards, including an Academy Award and a Primetime Emmy Award, and nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and two British Academy Film Awards. In 2017, he was named by Time as one of the most influential people in the world. He also created the TV series Englistan in 2018 for the BBC, which was also his writing debut. After studying acting at the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, Ahmed began his acting career with independent films such as The Road to Guantanamo (2006), Shifty (2008), Four Lions (2010), Trishna (2011), and The Reluctant Fundamentalist (2012).

conocida: Rogue One: Una historia de Star Wars

bio.en: Lambert Wilson (born August 3, 1958) is a French actor, singer, and activist. He is best known internationally for his portrayal of The Merovingian in The Matrix Reloaded, The Matrix Revolutions, and The Matrix Resurrections.

Rodrigo Sorogoyen del Amo (born 16 September 1981) is a Spanish film director and screenwriter. He won the Goya Award for Best Director and the Goya Award for Best Original Screenplay for The Realm. He was previously nominated for the Goya Award for Best New Director for Stockholm, the Goya Award for Best Director, and the Goya Award for Best Original Screenplay for May God Save Us. For the short film Mother, Sorogoyen won the Goya Award for Best Fictional Short Film and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film. He often works in tandem with Isabel Peña. Born on 16 September 1981 in Madrid, Rodrigo Sorogoyen is the grandson of filmmaker Antonio del Amo.

bio.ca: Victoria Luengo més coneguda com a Vicky Luengo (Palma, 7 d'abril de 1990) és una actriu nascuda a Mallorca, que va viure a Barcelona dels 4 als 18 anys. Va començar a fer teatre com a activitat extraescolar alhora que estudiava educació primària. Més tard va estar en una escola d'interpretació especialitzada (Escola Memory, a Barcelona). La primera vegada que va pujar a l'escenari de manera professional va ser amb 14 anys. El 2015 va ser guardonada al Festival Internacional de Cinema de la Ciutat de Nova York com a millor actiu principal en la pel·lícula Born de Claudio Zulian. El 2023 va ser guardonada amb el premi Gaudí a la millor actriu protagonista.

bio.en: **Naveen Kumar Gowda** (born 8 January 1986), known mononymously by his screen name **Yash**, is an Indian actor who primarily works in Kannada films. Widely referred to in the media as the "Rocking Star," he is one of the highest-paid and most bankable actors in the Kannada film industry. Born in Bhuvanahalli, a village in the Hassan district of Karnataka, to a father who worked as a KSRTC and BMTC bus driver, Yash spent his childhood in Mysore. He completed his pre-university education at Mahajana Education Society before pursuing a Bachelor of Arts at K.L.E. College in Bangalore.

conocida: Ramayana: El Nacimiento de una Leyenda

bio.en: Arun Govil (born 12 January 1958) is an Indian actor and politician. He is best known for portraying Lord Rama in the 1987 Ramayan TV series and reprising his role (voice acting) in the 1993 animated film, Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama. He also appeared in films like Paheli (1977), Sawan Ko Aane Do (1979), Saanch Ko Aanch Nahin (1979), Jiyo To Aise Jiyo (1981), Himmatwala (1983), Dilwaala (1986), and Govinda Govinda (1994).

conocida: Ramayana: El Nacimiento de una Leyenda

bio.en: Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Daniel Raim attended the American Film Institute in Los Angeles. Raim is known for his documentaries about overlooked artists of Hollywood's Golden Age, including "The Man on Lincoln's Nose" nominated for the 2001 Academy Award® for Best Documentary Short Subject. Raim's 2015 doc "Harold and Lillian A Hollywood Love Story" (a New York Times Critic's Pick) premiered as an Official Selection of the Cannes Film Festival and was nominated for The Golden Eye (L’Œil d'or, le prix du documentaire - Cannes).

conocida: Harold and Lillian: A Hollywood Love Story
Image Makers: The Adventures of America's Pioneer Cinematographers

bio.en: Sir Ben Kingsley (born Krishna Pandit Bhanji; 31 December 1943) is an English actor. He has received accolades throughout his career spanning five decades, including an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Grammy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards, as well as nominations for four Primetime Emmy Awards and two Laurence Olivier Awards. Kingsley was appointed Knight Bachelor in 2002 for services to the British film industry. He was awarded a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2010 and received the Britannia Award in 2013.

conocida: Shang-Chi y la leyenda de los Diez Anillos
t2282.lugar: Snainton, North Riding of Yorkshire, England, UK

bio.en: Jake Curran is a British actor whose career spans from 1978 to the present with over 50 credited roles. His date and place of birth are unconfirmed. His film credits include Stardust (2007), Robin Hood (2010), Fury (2014), Maze Runner: The Death Cure (2018), and Clayface (2026, post-production). On television he has appeared in Gangs of London (2022), The Salisbury Poisonings (2020), and Robin Hood (2025), and is currently filming as Ronan the Centaur in Harry Potter (2027). In theatre he appeared in The Play That Goes Wrong (West End, 2021). No major awards are on record.

conocida: El corredor del laberinto: La cura mortal

bio.en: Frédéric Pierrot (born 17 September 1960) is a French actor. He has appeared in more than 120 films and television shows since 1986. He starred in the film Tell Me I'm Dreaming, which was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1998 Cannes Film Festival. He is next seen in Abner Pastoll's film Road Games., released theatrically in the US by IFC Films. Source: Article "Frédéric Pierrot" from Wikipedia in English, licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.

Ayden Sng is a Singaporean actor who is fluent in English and Mandarin. He made his major acting debut in 2019 where he played the lead role in a short film. After signing with Mediacorp, Ayden has taken on several lead roles in shows and has expanded his portfolio into China. On top of his passion for acting, Ayden plays the violin, piano, and Er Hu. He is a former member of the Singapore National Youth Orchestra and graduated from Duke University.

bio.es: Hayao Miyazaki (Miyazaki Hayao, nacido el 5 de enero de 1941) es un dibujante de manga japonés y un destacado director de cine y animador de muchos largometrajes de anime populares. A lo largo de una carrera de casi cinco décadas, Miyazaki ha alcanzado la fama internacional como realizador de largometrajes de animación y, junto con Isao Takahata, cofundó Studio Ghibli, un estudio de animación y una productora. El éxito de las películas de Miyazaki ha hecho que se le compare con el animador estadounidense Walt Disney, el británico Nick Park y Robert Zemeckis, pionero de la animación por captura de movimiento, y ha sido nombrado una de las personas más influyentes por la revista Time.

Akio Otsuka (大塚 明夫, Ō tsuka Akio) es un actor de doblaje (seiyu) japonés de Tokio que está afiliado a Mausu Promotion. Es hijo del también actor de doblaje Chikao Otsuka. En febrero de 2005, se casó con la actriz de doblaje Yoko Soumi, pero se divorció de ella en 2009.

conocida: Teddy, la magia de la Navidad

bio.en: Charlotte Frogner (born April 4, 1981) is a Norwegian actress, best known outside of Norway for her role in the Norwegian Zombie film Dead Snow. She has been employed by Oslo's Det Norske Teatret since 2004 where she has appeared in a number of productions and acted for Norwegian television. Description above from the Wikipedia article Charlotte Frogner, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia. ​

bio.en: K.K. Moggie is an actress from New Zealand. She holds a MFA in acting from Columbia University.

bio.ca: Pierre Victor Théophile Bertin (Lilla, França, 24 d’octubre de 1891 - París, França, 13 de maig de 1984) va ser un actor de cinema i escenari francès. Va estar casat amb la pianista Marcelle Meyer.

bio.es: Maialen Gurbindo López, conocida artísticamente como Chica Sobresalto, es una cantante y compositora española.

bio.en: Franklin Patrick Herbert Jr. (October 8, 1920–February 11, 1986) was an American science-fiction author, best known for his 1965 novel Dune and its five sequels. He also wrote short stories and worked as a newspaper journalist, photographer, book reviewer, ecological consultant, and lecturer. Dune is the best-selling science fiction novel of all time, and the series is a classic of the science fiction genre.

bio.ca: José Vicente Ferrer de Otero y Cintrón (San Juan, 8 de gener de 1909 - Coral Gables, Florida, 26 de gener de 1992), conegut com José Ferrer, va ser un actor, director i guionista porto-riqueny. El 1933, es diploma per la Universitat de Princeton. Fa els seus inicis a Broadway el 1935.

conocida: La comedia sexual de una noche de verano

bio.es: Ryan Thomas Gosling (nacido el 12 de noviembre de 1980) es un actor canadiense. Destacado en el cine independiente, también ha trabajado en películas taquilleras de diversos géneros y ha acumulado una recaudación bruta en taquilla mundial de más de 1.900 millones de dólares. Ha recibido varios elogios, incluido un Globo de Oro y nominaciones a dos Premios de la Academia y un Premio BAFTA. Nacido y criado en Canadá, saltó a la fama a los 13 años por ser una estrella infantil en The Mickey Mouse Club de Disney Channel (1993-1995) y apareció en otros programas de entretenimiento familiar, incluido Are You Afraid of the Dark. ? (1995) y La piel de gallina (1996).

conocida: La ciudad de las estrellas (La La Land)

bio.es: Sonoya Mizuno (みずの・そのや) (nacida el 1 de julio de 1986) es una actriz, modelo y bailarina británica nacida en Japón. Es mejor conocida por sus colaboraciones con el director Alex Garland, como la película dramática de 2014 Ex Machina, Annihilation y la miniserie de Netflix de 2018 Maniac. También ha tenido papeles menores en las películas La La Land, La bella y la bestia y, más recientemente, en la comedia romántica del 2018 Crazy Rich Asians.

conocida: La ciudad de las estrellas (La La Land)

bio.en: Charles Berling (born 30 April 1958) is a French actor, director and screenwriter. Charles Berling, son of a navy doctor, is also the nephew of the literary critic Raymond Picard. His mother, Nadia, "only daughter of (French) settlers in Morocco" was born in Meknes (Morocco); she died in 2004. When he was two years old he left Paris for Brest, then Toulon, then, at seven, Tahiti. He studied acting at the Belgian school INSAS, in Brussels. He is the father of the actor Émile Berling. Source: Article "Charles Berling" from Wikipedia in English, licensed under CC-BY-SA.

Nagore Aranburu is a Spanish stage, film and television actress, screenwriter and director, best known for her leading role in the feature film Flowers as well as for her work in theatre (not to be confused with model Nagore Aranburu, wife of former Spanish footballer Xavier Alonso).

bio.es: Jeffrey Leon Bridges (4 de diciembre de 1949), mejor conocido como Jeff Bridges, es un actor, músico, productor, fotógrafo, dibujante, narrador y viticultor estadounidense ganador del premio Óscar, del Globo de Oro, del Premio del Sindicato de Actores y del Premio Cecil B. DeMille por su trayectoria profesional. Es hijo del legendario actor Lloyd Bridges.

bio.en: Lux Balmaceda Pascal (born June 4, 1992) is an American and Chilean actress and transgender activist. She is known for her roles in the Chilean television series Veinteañero a los 40 and "uana Brava, as well as the Chilean drama film The Prince. Description above from the Wikipedia article Lux Pascal, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

bio.ca: Ann Miller, nascuda Johnnie Lucille Collier (Houston, Texas, 12 d'abril de 1923 - Los Angeles, Califòrnia, 22 de gener de 2004), va ser una actriu, ballarina i cantant nord-americana. Se la recorda sobretot pel seu treball als musicals de cinema clàssic de Hollywood dels anys quaranta i cinquanta.

bio.es: Elena Anaya (nacida el 17 de julio de 1975) es una actriz española cuya carrera se remonta a 1995. Anaya nació en Palencia, España, el 17 de julio de 1975. Es la menor de 5 hijos. Recibió atención internacional por primera vez en 2001 por su papel en el drama sexualmente explícito Lucía y el sexo (Sex and Lucía) y también apareció en Hable con ella (Hable con ella) de Pedro Almodóvar. Su papel más conocido en la película de Hollywood fue como vampiro en 2004 en Van Helsing, interpretando a la novia de Drácula, Aleera. También aparece en el video musical de Justin Timberlake para su single de 2006, SexyBack.

t3623.lugar: Palencia, Palencia, Castilla y León, Spain

bio.en: James Earl Jones (January 17, 1931 – September 9, 2024) was an American actor. He was described as "one of America's most distinguished and versatile" actors for his performances on stage and screen, and "one of the greatest actors in American history". Over his career, he received three Tony Awards, two Emmy Awards, and a Grammy Award. He was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 1985. He was honored with the National Medal of Arts in 1992, the Kennedy Center Honor in 2002, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2009 and the Honorary Academy Award in 2011.

conocida: Rogue One: Una historia de Star Wars
La guerra de las galaxias. Episodio III: La venganza de los Sith

bio.es: Escritora. Me interesé por el mundo del teatro desde pequeña. Primero como espectadora, después empecé clases de interpretación, y con 18 años me apunté a mi primer curso de dramaturgia en la Sala Beckett. Sin duda, Javier Daulte y Sergi Belbel, fueron los profesores que más me marcaron. Por aquel entonces estudiaba filología hispánica y pronto lo dejé para pasarme al Institut del Teatre de Barcelona, dónde me licencié en Dirección y Dramaturgia. Aún no había terminado y estrené en el Teatre Versus de Barcelona, dos obras a la vez. Una en horario de tarde y la otra de noche.

Muntsa Alcañiz (Constantí, Tarragonès, 4 de Mayo de 1954) es una actriz y profesora de interpretación de l'Institut del Teatre de la Diputación de Barcelona. El año 1985 fue galardonada con el Premio Margarida Xirgu.

bio.es: Isaac "Isak" Férriz Álvaro (Andorra, 20 de junio de 1979) es un actor y director andorrano. Miembro de la Asociación Artística Indi Gest. Se formó como actor en la Escuela de Teatro de Nancy Tuñón en Barcelona.

Àngel Llàcer Pinós (16 de enero de 1974) es un actor, director teatral y presentador de televisión español. Es especialmente conocido a raíz de su participación en los programas Operación Triunfo, Tú sí que vales, las ocho ediciones de Tu cara me suena, incluyendo Tu cara me suena mini y Tu cara no me suena todavía y los especiales.
